title: 第三十六章 初闻战争掠夺
content_zh:
第三十六章 初闻战争掠夺-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》

上一章

存书签

下一章

“虽然我说过我是站在他们这边的，但事实上，在成为NPC的那一刻，就已经不可能了，只不过是因为现在才刚刚起步，所以我才需要帮着这些人，要不然，他们输掉这场游戏，作为蓝星唯一的NPC，等待我的估计也不是什么好下场吧。”

听到爻雪这样说，系统沉默了，因为他知道爻雪说的都是对的。

爻雪之所以会成为NPC，就是因为她是异界之魂，对这颗星球没有太多的感情，同时又因为她也是人类，不会出现厌恶人类的情绪。

诸神需要的是一个能够让游戏变得有趣起来的NPC。

【宿主猜的没错，NPC的命运确实是跟星球的输赢联系在一起的，一旦这颗星球上的所有幸存者灭绝，那么NPC也会死亡，这个消息是在游戏商店升级到三级之后才会获得的信息。

另外，在游戏商店升级到三级之后，便会开启战争掠夺模式。】

“战争掠夺，是我理解的那个意思吗？”爻雪道。

【本系统没有读心术，不知道宿主所说的是什么意思，但战争掠夺便是由NPC自己选择本星球的十名最强者，然后进入其他星球进行掠夺战争。

同样是末日游戏，每个星球的末世是不同的，你们的任务便是掠夺那些本星球没有的资源，让自己的星球重新恢复正常。

另外，每一颗星球的资源都是有限的，一旦这颗星球上的资源被其他星球掠夺干净，身为NPC的你会死亡，而这颗星球上的人要么选择成为侵略者，彻底攻占其他星球，要么在自己星球上等死】

听完系统的解释之后，爻雪有些沉默，她原本以为这只是一个末世生存游戏，结果没有想到后面还有战斗机制。

他们可以组织人手去其他星球进行掠夺，同样的，其他星球的幸存者也可以在他们NPC的带领下来到她所在的蓝星进行掠夺资源。

“系统，现在蓝星可掠夺的资源有哪些？”爻雪问道。

【抱歉宿主，你现在等级不够，现在还无法查看这些信息】

Chapter 36: First hearing about war plunder - "Apocalyptic Invasion: I am an NPC in the dungeon"

"Although I said I was on their side, in fact, the moment I became an NPC, it was already impossible. It's just because I have just started, so I need to help these people. Otherwise, they lose this game. As the only NPC in Blue Star, waiting for me will probably not be a good end."

Hearing what Yaoxue said, the system fell silent, because he knew that what Yaoxue said was right.

The reason why Yaoxue became an NPC is because she is a soul from another world and does not have much affection for this planet. At the same time, because she is also a human being, she does not have the emotion to hate human beings.

What the gods need is an NPC who can make the game interesting.

[The host guessed correctly. The fate of the NPC is indeed linked to the victory or defeat of the planet. Once all the survivors on the planet are extinct, the NPC will also die. This information will only be obtained after the game store is upgraded to level three.

In addition, after the game store is upgraded to level three, the war plunder mode will be enabled.】

"War and plunder, is that what I understand it to mean?" Yaoxue said.

[This system does not have the ability to read minds, so I don’t know what the host means, but war plunder is for the NPC to select the ten strongest people on the planet, and then enter other planets to carry out plunder wars.

It is also a doomsday game. The end of each planet is different. Your task is to plunder resources that your planet does not have and restore your planet to normal.

In addition, the resources of each planet are limited. Once the resources on this planet are plundered by other planets, you as an NPC will die, and the people on this planet will either choose to become invaders and completely capture other planets, or wait to die on their own planet]

After listening to the system's explanation, Yaoxue was a little silent. She originally thought this was just a post-apocalyptic survival game, but she didn't expect that there was a combat mechanism behind it.

They can organize people to go to other planets to plunder. Similarly, survivors from other planets can also lead their NPCs to come to the blue star where she is to plunder resources.

"System, what are the resources that Blue Star can plunder now?" Yaoxue asked.

[Sorry host, you are not level enough now and cannot view this information yet]
